metadata.label: Electricity use in Sweden by area of use (NACE Rev. 2). Year 2008-2025
note: Summations may differ between tables due to rounding.

The distribution of electricity consumption by area of use is encumbered by uncertainty. This is most likely due to on-going revisions and reclassifications of customers in the net operators customer directories. This may result in great disparities for specific categories from one year to the next.

Starting with the reference year 2021, the distribution of the categories 'Steam and air conditioning supply, operation of heating plant' and 'Steam and air conditioning supply, heat pumps and electric boilers' is model calculated as the source of these categories has been replaced.
Starting with the reference year 2023 data on export, transmission network losses and losses excluding transmission network losses are retrieved from Svenska kraftnät.
Until reference year 2022, total losses are calculated as Total electricity supply-Total final consumption excl. Losses-Export.
Starting with reference year 2023 a statistical difference is reported.
Export refers to electricity transfer from Sweden to other countries. Loop force is excluded.
